text.talk: The group spent a while on background. Tooling came up: the dashboards the two teams use day to day, how long exports take and which columns people ignore. Someone described the office move and the new floor plan, with the meeting rooms now named after rivers. There was a short exchange about hiring in general, the season, and travel. The team shared how their week is organized, with a planning block on Monday and reviews on Friday. Several screenshots were shown and nobody had remarks. A recent industry report was mentioned in passing; nobody had read it in full. The group also went over the glossary of terms both sides use, so that "account", "site" and "location" mean the same in later calls. Audio was poor for a few minutes and part of the talk was repeated.
text.team: The internal update walked through each department in turn. Support reported the usual volumes and a new rota. Finance presented the monthly close and asked everyone to file expenses on time. Product demoed three small improvements. People announced the summer picnic and the updated holiday calendar. Facilities explained the badge system. Marketing showed the new banner and collected reactions. Questions were taken at the end.
